newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas has more South Texas success.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas has more South Texas success.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp said its initial wells drilled in Live Oak and Goliad Counties resulted in discoveries. Both areas are new to TransTexas operations.

The Hoskin Fee No. 1 well in Live Oak County logged 26 feet of pay in the Wilcox formation after being drilled to a depth of 13,100 feet. Early indications are that additional pay exists in the area, and plans are in place to start a second well this month.
In Goliad County, the Strong G.U. No. 1 well logged 79 feet of Wilcox pay in five zones.
Completion on both wells is currently under way.
